scope: read-only production audit, no model tuning or promotion

sample.random_reporting: separate from targeted; small sample, no corpus-wide guarantee

authority: engineering targets frozen before further tuning; owner review pending; not authorization to ship
cost_rule: unknown when usage or billing attribution is absent; never report zero by assumption
split_rule: inherit verified full family map when available; quarantine unknown families; seed failures tuning/stress; held-out results report-only; existing benchmark lock unchanged
human_review: owner independently reviews 12 images, with no model caption initially shown; disagreements resolved before closing issue
hypothesis: identity coverage can be correct while generated metadata and retrieval are poor; audit can falsify blanket-regeneration assumption
compute: local CPU/network only; no GPU; live reads bounded; no production writes
